component.name: ComdTeX
component.summary: Markdown + LaTeX editor for mathematics and science

description.p: ComdTeX is a desktop editor for academic writing in Markdown + LaTeX, aimed at mathematicians and scientists. Your files are plain text in a folder you own: no database, no hidden format, no cloud. Free forever.

ul.li: Shorthands that expand to LaTeX on Tab: frac(1, n+1), sum(i=0, n), nestable
Numbered theorem environments, equations, figures and cross-references
PDF compilation with a bundled WASM LaTeX engine, no TeX install required
BibTeX citations with DOI/arXiv fetch and Zotero import
Interoperable with Obsidian vaults and Overleaf-ready .tex export
Bilingual interface, English and Spanish, with full parity
AI strictly optional and off by default, bring your own provider
